create_table_bucketing_config: create a TableBucketingConfig dataclass instance to configure Parquet table bucketing for fairseq2 data pipelines
configure_fragment_concatenation: configure TableBucketingConfig with min_fragment_number and target_table_size to control fragment concatenation into batches
configure_batch_splitting: configure TableBucketConfig with batch_size and order_by_length to split concatenated tables into smaller batches
configure_length_ordering: configure TableBucketingConfig with length_columns and total_batch_length to order rows by sequence length for efficient padding
configure_caching_performance: configure TableBucketingConfig with cache and cache_dir to memory map large tables and reduce memory footprint
